selection_rule: Latest20 distinct acquisition timestamps intersecting fixed bbox; select one cataloged plume complex at each timestamp with largest metadata valid-pixel count (ties by NASA item ID). First2 known plume products reserved for numeric/geospatial validation. Remaining18 are catalog-conditioned screens, not unbiased full-scene search.
bias: Plume product selected/masked by NASA. Suitable plume-free controls and new emissions outside product support unavailable.

export.provider: NASA US Greenhouse Gas Center EIC Raster API
export.expected_band2: validity/alpha mask from raster service, not retrieval uncertainty
